name: OnContact CRM
description_en:
OnContact CRM is the WorkWise customer-relationship product named in Aptean’s official acquisition announcement. Current Aptean CRM documentation still uses OnContact tags in its Outlook synchronization workflow, providing a concrete link to the current product family. This profile follows that documented lineage into Aptean CRM 10 while retaining the catalog’s original OnContact slug and name. It does not promise that every legacy OnContact contract includes today’s modules.

The useful operating unit is a linked company, contact, opportunity and activity history. A sales team can qualify an opportunity, record amount and decision-maker, schedule a demonstration and remind the representative to update the outcome. Current documentation gives conditions and actions for that sequence, rather than only a broad sales-automation claim. No subscription, activation, Outlook sync, business process, imported data or ERP integration was executed.
description_zh:
OnContact CRM 是 Aptean 官方收购公告中具名的 WorkWise 客户关系产品。当前 Aptean CRM 文档的 Outlook 同步流程仍使用 OnContact 标签，为现有产品家族提供了具体关联。本档案沿这条文档链介绍 Aptean CRM 10，同时保留目录原 OnContact 名称和 slug；不承诺每份旧 OnContact 合同都包含当前模块。

实际工作单位是关联的公司、联系人、商机及活动历史。销售团队可完成商机资格确认，记录金额和决策人，安排演示，再提醒负责人更新结果。当前文档给出了这条流程的条件及动作，而不只是泛称销售自动化。未执行订阅、激活、Outlook 同步、业务流程、数据导入或 ERP 集成。

core_features.explanation_en: Track projected/sold amount, close date/probability, contacts, open/completed activities, milestones, notes and attachments around the opportunity.
core_features.explanation_zh: 围绕商机追踪预计／成交金额、结单日期／概率、联系人、待办／已完成活动、里程碑、备注及附件。

core_features.explanation_en: Create entity-targeted steps that change data, notify a representative and create follow-up activities after qualifying conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按实体建立步骤，在满足条件后修改数据、通知负责人及创建跟进活动。

core_features.explanation_en: Designate contacts/activities and tagged Outlook-folder items for synchronization; the latest change wins if both sides edit.
core_features.explanation_zh: 指定联系人／活动及 Outlook 文件夹带标签项目同步；双端都编辑时采用最后更改。

core_features.explanation_en: Current product page describes pipeline, multi-phase campaigns, service and contact-centre integration; order-specific modules still require confirmation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 当前产品页描述销售管线、多阶段营销、服务和联络中心集成；仍需确认订单所含模块。

en: A sales operations team standardizing qualification, demonstration and follow-up around linked opportunity records.
An existing OnContact customer comparing current Aptean documentation with its own version, licensed modules and Outlook workflow.
zh: 围绕关联商机规范资格确认、演示及后续跟进的销售运营团队。
将现有版本、许可模块和 Outlook 流程与当前 Aptean 文档比较的 OnContact 老客户。
use_cases.basis: Editorial guidance from documented records and actions, not observed adoption or migration success.

Current documented version.en: Aptean CRM10 documentation dated September17 2026 describes the operational examples; the historical acquisition supports lineage but does not establish current feature parity or automatic migration.
Current documented version.zh: 2026 年 9 月 17 日的 Aptean CRM 10 文档描述本文作业示例；历史收购证明产品脉络，不证明当前功能等价或自动迁移。

steps.en: Confirm the current Aptean CRM version, licensed modules, hosting arrangement, legacy migration scope and written commercial terms before activation.
steps.zh: 激活前确认当前 Aptean CRM 版本、许可模块、托管方式、旧版迁移范围及书面商业条款。

steps.en: Follow AppCentral activation and wait for the completed-deployment confirmation; populate mandatory company details before opening the CRM workspace.
steps.zh: 按 AppCentral 流程激活并等待部署完成确认，填写必填公司资料后再打开 CRM 工作区。

steps.en: Pilot one linked opportunity and qualification process, then one designated Outlook contact; test missing data, concurrent edits, sync delay and access removal before broad rollout.
steps.zh: 试跑一条关联商机及资格流程，再试一个指定 Outlook 联系人；扩量前测试缺字段、双端编辑、同步延迟及撤销访问。

items.name: Outlook Add-in
items.scope: Selected CRM contacts/activities and OnContact-tagged items in configured Outlook folders; not an unconditional whole-mailbox mirror.

items.name: ERP and CTI
items.scope: Product-level integration positioning; exact ERP edition, connector availability, mapping, write permissions, retry policy and fees were not verified.

items.en: Current Aptean CRM documentation is not a guarantee that every legacy OnContact installation or contract includes the same fields, modules or deployment rights.
items.zh: 当前 Aptean CRM 文档不保证所有旧 OnContact 安装或合同具备相同字段、模块或部署权利。

items.en: An opportunity qualifies for the documented second step only after the qualifying activity closes, amount exists and a decision-maker contact is present. Incomplete data can leave follow-up pending.
items.zh: 示例第二步需资格活动已关闭、金额有值且存在决策人联系人；字段不完整可能使后续任务继续等待。

items.en: If linked Outlook and CRM records both change, the most recent change is applied. This is a conflict rule, not a verified field-by-field merge or guaranteed instant delivery.
items.zh: Outlook 和 CRM 关联记录双端都改时采用最后更改；这是冲突规则，不是已核字段级合并或即时送达保证。

items.en: AppCentral activation starts deployment/onboarding; the initiated status is not equivalent to a ready workspace. Required company fields gate setup submission.
items.zh: AppCentral 激活会启动部署／引导；已发起不等于工作区就绪，必填公司字段决定能否提交设置。

items.en: No current public amount, billing unit, minimum, trial entitlement, renewal/cancellation terms or complete license was established. Historical directory pricing is not adopted.
items.zh: 未建立当前公开金额、计费单位、最低量、试用权益、续订／取消条款或完整许可，不采用旧目录价。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current product and onboarding documents were read, but no reliable current price schedule was established. Amount, billing unit, module/implementation/integration fees, minimum, trial, renewal and cancellation remain unknown. The historical directory 40 figure is not a verified offer.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 已读当前产品及引导文档，但未建立可靠现行价表。金额、计费单位、模块／实施／集成费用、最低量、试用、续订及取消均未知；旧目录 40 不是已核报价。

faq.question_en: Is this every Aptean product combined?
faq.question_zh: 这是否汇总了 Aptean 所有产品？
faq.answer_en: No. The scope follows WorkWise OnContact into current CRM documentation, supported by the acquisition announcement and OnContact tags. Other ERP and service products do not automatically become CRM entitlements.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。范围沿 WorkWise OnContact 进入当前 CRM 文档，由收购公告和 OnContact 标签支撑；其他 ERP 或服务产品不自动成为 CRM 权益。

faq.question_en: Will Outlook synchronize every item automatically?
faq.question_zh: Outlook 会自动同步所有项目吗？
faq.answer_en: The guide requires designated CRM records and configured Outlook folders with OnContact-tagged items. Linked edits use the latest-change rule; manual Sync is available for network delay.
faq.answer_zh: 指南要求指定 CRM 记录，并配置 Outlook 文件夹内带 OnContact 标签的项目；关联编辑采用最后更改规则，网络延迟时可手动 Sync。

sections.title_en: Use the OnContact lineage without assuming contract equivalence
sections.title_zh: 沿 OnContact 脉络研究，不假设合同等价
sections.en:
Aptean’s acquisition announcement explicitly identifies WorkWise’s OnContact CRM and describes sales, marketing, service and contact-centre scope. Current Aptean CRM10 documentation supplies a second concrete connection: the Outlook Add-in still processes items tagged OnContact. Those are the basis for updating the canonical website to Aptean’s current named CRM page while preserving the catalog identifier. The original WorkWise URL is not used as proof of today’s offer.

The acquisition announcement’s cloud/on-premise statement is historical. Current AppCentral onboarding describes activation and deployment, not an all-edition deployment matrix. Existing customers need version, hosting, modules and migration rights confirmed against their actual agreement. This profile does not silently turn all Aptean ERP, payments or business applications into OnContact capabilities.
sections.zh:
Aptean 收购公告明确指出 WorkWise 的 OnContact CRM，并描述销售、营销、服务及联络中心范围。当前 Aptean CRM 10 文档提供第二条具体联系：Outlook 插件仍处理带 OnContact 标签的项目。以此将权威网址更新到 Aptean 当前具名 CRM 页，保留目录标识；不把原 WorkWise 地址当作当前供应证明。

收购公告的云端／本地部署说法属于历史。当前 AppCentral 引导描述激活及部署，而不是全部版本部署矩阵。老客户应按真实协议核对版本、托管、模块及迁移权利。本档案不把 Aptean 的全部 ERP、支付或业务应用并成 OnContact 功能。

sections.title_en: Make the opportunity a connected working record
sections.title_zh: 让商机成为关联工作记录
sections.en:
CRM10 opportunities hold company/contact links, expected close date, probability, projected and sold amount, profile information and recent activity. History includes open and completed appointments, calls, meetings and emails; additional tabs cover milestones, notes, attachments and assigned business processes. Creating an opportunity from a company or contact can populate that relationship rather than leaving it isolated.

For an illustrative equipment sale, keep the buyer contact, decision-maker role, amount, next activity and expected close date on the opportunity. The record then gives the representative and manager a common follow-up view. These fields organize work; a populated probability is not an independently calibrated forecast, and an attachment does not prove a signed agreement. Import deduplication, attachment limits, permissions and complete export/restore were not tested.
sections.zh:
CRM 10 商机保存公司／联系人关联、预计结单日、概率、预计及成交金额、资料信息和近期活动；历史包含待办及已完成的预约、电话、会议和邮件，另有里程碑、备注、附件及所属业务流程。从公司或联系人创建商机可填入关联，避免孤立记录。

假设设备销售，应在商机中保留买方联系人、决策人角色、金额、下一活动和预计日期，让销售与经理共享跟进视图。这些字段组织工作，但填入概率不是独立校准预测，附件也不证明合同已签。导入去重、附件限额、权限和完整导出／恢复未实测。

sections.title_en: Qualification progresses only when the recorded conditions are met
sections.title_zh: 资格确认仅在记录条件满足后推进
sections.en:
The business-process guide gives an unusually concrete three-step sequence. After a representative is assigned, a condition selects that opportunity, an action sets its stage to Qualifying, another sends an email, and another creates an activity to identify the decision-maker and value. The next step waits for the qualification activity to close, an amount to exist and a contact with the Decision Maker role. It then creates the demonstration-scheduling task; a later step reminds the representative to update details after the demonstration activities close.

This is an explicit data-dependent handoff, not proof that the system itself discovers a buyer or performs the demonstration. Before deployment, test a missing decision-maker, an unclosed task, a reassigned representative and a failed notification. Confirm the resulting activity and stage, not just a saved diagram. Retry, duplicate-action prevention and transactional rollback were not established in this guide.
sections.zh:
业务流程指南给出具体三步：分配负责人后，条件选中商机，动作将阶段设为 Qualifying，再发邮件并创建识别决策人和价值的活动。下一步等待资格活动关闭、金额有值、并存在 Decision Maker 角色联系人，再创建安排演示的任务；后一步在演示活动关闭后提醒更新资料。

这是一条依赖记录数据的交接，不证明系统自行找到买方或执行演示。上线前应测试无决策人、任务未关闭、负责人变更及通知失败，确认结果活动与阶段，而不只是图保存成功。该指南未建立重试、重复动作防护或事务回滚保证。

sections.title_en: Outlook sync has selection and conflict boundaries
sections.title_zh: Outlook 同步有选择范围和冲突边界
sections.en:
For CRM contacts and activities, the guide requires Options > Sync with Outlook. Successfully linked records show End Sync with Outlook, which can stop the automatic relationship. In Outlook, administrators/users configure folders and the Add-in processes items tagged OnContact. Changes then synchronize without exporting the item again. This is selected-record synchronization, not a promise that every mailbox item is copied.

When linked items change in both applications, the latest change is applied. A user can manually run Sync if a network delay occurs. For an illustrative pilot, edit one linked contact in one application, verify the other, then deliberately test a two-sided conflict and ending sync. Last-change handling does not establish field-level merging, latency bounds, recovery from deletion or full mailbox portability. Those require the chosen Add-in version, access policy and account configuration.
sections.zh:
CRM 联系人及活动需用 Options > Sync with Outlook 指定；关联成功后出现 End Sync with Outlook，可结束自动关系。Outlook 中配置文件夹，由插件处理带 OnContact 标签的项目；之后更改无需重新导出即可同步。这是选择记录同步，不承诺复制整个邮箱。

两端关联项目都更改时采用最后更改；网络延迟时用户可手动 Sync。假设试点先改单端联系人并核对另一端，再刻意测试双端冲突及结束同步。最后更改规则不建立字段级合并、延迟上限、删除恢复或完整邮箱迁移，需按插件版本、访问策略及账户配置确认。

sections.title_en: Activation, commercial scope and practical fit
sections.title_zh: 激活、商业范围及实际适配
sections.en:
AppCentral activation moves through Initiated Activation and Deployment Started and creates an onboarding case with customer, company and module details. A confirmation email follows completed activation. Setup then opens a company-details wizard partly populated from the license subscription; mandatory fields must be filled before Submit, and Open appears after successful setup. An initiated tile is therefore not sufficient evidence that a usable CRM workspace exists.

Current pricing remains not verified. The product page offers sales contact rather than a verified price schedule, and onboarding mentions a license subscription without establishing the legal grant. Amount, seat/module units, minimums, implementation, Outlook/ERP connector fees, trial rights, renewal, cancellation and export rights are still unknown. Do not normalize the old directory 40 figure into a current monthly rate.

The documented flow is a reasonable fit for a team willing to maintain linked records, qualification conditions and follow-up ownership, or an existing OnContact customer checking current behavior. A team requiring an immediate self-service purchase, verified permanent free use, guaranteed bidirectional field merging or confirmed legacy feature parity needs more evidence before selection. Public documentation is not hands-on acceptance of deployment, security or migration.
sections.zh:
AppCentral 激活会经过 Initiated Activation 和 Deployment Started，并按客户、公司及模块资料建立引导工单；激活完成后发送确认邮件。设置打开公司资料向导，部分字段来自许可订阅，必填信息填完才能 Submit，设置成功才出现 Open。因此仅见已发起状态不足以证明 CRM 工作区可用。

现行价格保持未核实。产品页提供销售联系而非已核价表，引导提到许可订阅却不建立法律授权。金额、座席／模块单位、最低量、实施、Outlook／ERP 连接器费用、试用、续订、取消及导出权仍未知，不把旧目录 40 规范化成当前月费。

对于愿意维护关联记录、资格条件及后续责任的团队，或核对当前行为的 OnContact 老客户，文档流程具有合理适配性。若要求立即自助购买、已核永久免费、保证双向字段合并或旧版功能完全等价，应先补足证据。公开文档不是部署、安全或迁移的实测验收。

research_gaps: Current price, units, minimum, trial, implementation/connector fees and full commercial agreement remain unverified.
Current hosting/deployment matrix and legal license grant were not established; acquisition-era deployment claims are historical.
Exact legacy OnContact migration/contract parity is unknown.
Outlook synchronization latency, deletion recovery, field-level conflict behavior and access-removal handling were not executed.
ERP connector mapping, API limits/retries, record permissions, retention and full export/restore were not verified.
